The linguistic judgement in these receipts is the delegated run's, but it spans those models, which is why the chain is recorded rather than a single name.

findings.current: 你无法打开此对话。你可能不是对话成员，也可能该对话已归档。
findings.proposed: 你无法访问此对话。你可能不是对话成员，也可能该对话已归档。
findings.reason: '无法打开' renders 'open' as the interface action and reads as a load failure; the source asserts a permission state, and the other six locales all use access wording. '访问' is the locale's access verb (66 uses, including the no-access headline) and matches the two reasons the next sentence offers.

findings.proposed: 你可能不是该对话的成员
findings.reason: '对话成员' is a bare compound where the source says 'a member of it'; adding 该…的 pins the referent to the conversation just named, and also settles the 此/该 mix inside one string (此对话 … 该对话).

limitations: No rendered evidence: this role has no browser tool and the host is source-only, so fit is judged by character and cell count, not a rendered frame - no maxCells is declared for this key in the en sidecar. fr (117 chars, +19%) and vi (112, +14%) are the two a rendered check should look at first. ur was checked at the code-point level only (no bidi controls, correct Urdu stops, no Latin run); there is no FriBidi or terminal render. Translator provenance (job 64be94d56ced) is inherited from the prior receipts rather than re-verified - what this run did verify is that the delivered strings are byte-identical to those audited. This run is a delegated subagent with no session id of its own, so the instance id is the parent's; and the model changed mid-run under provider quota (see model_provenance), so the judgement spans more than one model. i18n/ledger.json is itself unmerged (UU) at this merge: the working-tree copy read here takes main's rows (c6f6f47ef39d-r2-* with main's target bytes), while the branch side of the conflict names the b393dc8cd01c-notavail-* receipts against the pre-merge branch bytes, so previous_receipt/previous_target_sha256 follow the working tree and the main side - resolving the conflict the other way would change what 'previous' means, not the bytes audited.
